about_the_game:
Get drawn into the story of an RPG game with turn-based combat and comedy elements connecting both fantasy and the real world! Choose your avatar, gather new companions, battle fierce enemies, craft mighty artefacts, learn new spells and most importantly... become the hero Lyfael needs!

The Beginning of Your Story

  • Engaging Intro Sequence:  Dive into the immersive world with an intriguing intro that sets the stage for your journey. Get a taste of the story and key characters that will shape your adventure.

  • Explore the First Location: Begin your adventure in a detailed and atmospheric first location, filled with interactive elements and early quests that introduce you to the core mechanics of the game.

Shape Your Combat Experience

  • Dynamic Combat Mechanics: Experience the combat system, including smooth combos, strategic spell-casting, and tactical use of different weapons.

  • Weapon and Spell Testing: Experiment with a variety of weapons and spells, giving you a hands-on opportunity to find your combat style and explore the game’s depth.

  • Tailor Your Party: Try out different characters with unique abilities, providing a glimpse into the diverse playstyles available in the full game.

Advanced Areas & Immersive Experience

  • Mid-to-Late Game Areas Preview: Unlock a sneak peek of later-stage areas, showcasing more advanced environments and the escalating stakes of the narrative.

  • Visual and Audio Immersion: Enjoy rich visuals, atmospheric soundtracks, and dynamic effects that enhance the immersion of your RPG experience.

Note about the demo:

Thank you for deciding to try our demo! Please note that this version does not include all the features and content of the full game. In the demo, you can try out the basic game mechanics, such as the combat system, and get a glimpse into the world we've created.

Please note that the final version of the game will offer much more - including an expanded story, additional artifacts, new characters and interesting quests. Your feedback is valuable to us, so please feel free to share your impressions and opinions.

The demo will only be available until the full game is released!

Enjoy playing and we look forward to your support!

*The game is currently only in English and there are no current plans to translate the full game into other languages.*

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 / 10
  • Processor: Intel® Atom x5-Z8350 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® UHD Graphics or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keep in mind that these specs may not be able to handle the game at a stable 60FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 / 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
